config.conditional_model: For hard selection at c, fitting above tau requires excesses above max(tau,c); oracle correction is equivalent to conditioning the likelihood on selection. Independent pilot minimum is >=c only under this hard-selection model.
config.decision: No automatic primary promotion. Report all cells, data costs, availability, conditional/unconditional coverage, paired comparisons. MC family bounds for fixed primary over the four hard scenarios; soft selection descriptive only. q=.001 is not validated.

method_definitions.independent_floor: tau=max(calibration quantile,min independent support-pilot failure); fit only evaluation tasks
method_definitions.observed_minimum: tau=max(calibration quantile,min evaluation failure); same-sample support selection
method_definitions.oracle_correct_selection: hard-selection diagnostic only: tau=max(calibration quantile,known true selection cutoff); never available on soft selection or real proofs
method_definitions.original: GPD on evaluation values above calibration quantile tau
method_definitions.pooled_original: calibration-only tau; pool independent pilot and evaluation tasks, giving a baseline matched to the same total failure-data budget

config.model_scope: Hard scenarios have exact GPD threshold stability above the selection cutoff. Soft scenario targets recovery of parent/asymptotic tail shape only; the finite selected distribution is not assumed GPD and is not part of the four-scenario calibration family.
config.random_streams: SeedSequence([role,seed]): roles 0/1/2 are calibration/evaluation/support generation. Bootstrap role=100+10*budget_id+group_id, group 0 calibration,1 evaluation,2 support,3 pooled. Budgets use nested calibration data and separate deterministic bootstrap streams. All methods share their group resamples; pooled_original resamples all 96 failure tasks.
config.unchanged_estimator: byte-identical constrained candidate from p3_constrained_v1; primary production code remains unchanged
